judgments.reason: The span 'blurred vision and redness in her right eye' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports lateralization of optic neuritis to the right eye.
The span 'Best-corrected visual acuity was +2 logMAR (hand movement) OD' appears literally in the vignette; OD denotes the right eye and the severely reduced acuity supports right optic neuritis.

The span listing right eye findings including relative afferent pupil defect, central scotoma, pupillary edema, and peripapillary hemorrhages appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports right optic neuritis as the diagnosis.
